descendants_plus.hop_1:
Kongo language was spoken by those taken as slaves and its creolized forms are found in ritual speech of Afro-American religions, especially in Brazil, Cuba, and Haiti. These religions derive from traditional African religions with some influence from Christianity.

FINDING: Kongo language
